### What & why
Briefly describe the change and the motivation. Link any related issue
(e.g. `Closes #123`).

### Type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling

### Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] Tests added/updated where it makes sense; `npm run test:all` passes
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or setup changed (README / docs / CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data added to the repo

### Security / crypto impact
Does this touch the E2EE / auth / key-handling paths? If yes, describe the impact
(and consider the disclosure policy in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)).

### Screenshots / notes
Anything reviewers should see or know.
